email_body:
Dear Novable Team,

I am writing to apply for the Front-end Developer Intern position at Novable. As a junior developer with hands-on experience in React and a strong foundation in web technologies, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your product team and support your mission of enabling innovation through startup relations.

In my previous role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. More recently, I have been building and maintaining WordPress sites, which has sharpened my problem-solving skills and attention to detail. I am comfortable with git version control and have basic knowledge of MySQL, and I am eager to deepen my understanding of Django and Python to better support your backend.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and can regularly commute to Brussels for the required two office days per week. I am curious, autonomous, and not afraid to ask questions when stuck—qualities I believe align well with your team culture.

I would love the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Novable. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
